title: Crucible shadow.v2 — grade-time settled cross-section
description: The produce-time cross-section (cross_section.v2) joined against the realized forward return, written ONLY once the horizon has settled, at experiments/{arm}/{trading_day}/cross_section_settled.json. Never the same key as cross_section.json and never written before produce/grade separate the two acts (mirrors shadow.json/verdict.json). `crucible.report` reduces this artifact, per settled decision date, into the R/M rows' rank IC (alpha-engine-config-I9778).

trading_day.description: The anchor session — the day the cross-section was produced.

horizon_trading_days.description: The count of TRADING sessions between trading_day and settled_on, as measured by crucible.slots.grading.forward_returns — never a calendar unit (§4.12).

settled_on.description: The session the forward return settled at.

population_size.description: The number of names in the produce-time cross-section this document joins against.

n_settled.description: Of population_size, how many carry a non-null realized_forward_return_ratio. A ticker without a settled close at both ends is ABSENT from settlement, never zero.

realized_forward_return_ratio.description: null when this ticker never settled (delisted, halted, no close at both ends) — absent, not zero.
